note: Live run: 100 ground-truth scenarios scored with the real agent (claude-sonnet-4-5, prompt analysis.v5) and LLM judge (claude-opus-4-5). v5 fixed calibration: after the reliability report showed the agent was under-confident (right ~88% but labeling channels medium/low), v5 redefined confidence as rank-certainty and defaults to 'high'. ECE fell from 0.263 (v4) to 0.093 — now passing — with the composite rising to 0.897 and 5 of 6 targets met. Accuracy = agent's own channel ranking vs. ground-truth ROI (Spearman); calibration = ECE of per-channel confidence against within-one-position rank correctness; groundedness/actionability are Opus-judged against cached gold-standard references. CORRECTION (Aug 2026): the hallucination_rate above (0.1034) was produced by an earlier formula, 1 - mean_judge_score/5, which conflated ordinary imperfection (a 4/5) with fabrication and overstated the rate. It has since been redefined as a true response-level rate — the fraction of responses the judge flags (hallucination score < 3 on an anchored 0-5 rubric) as containing a material invented or unsupported claim. Under the corrected metric, a live re-run (n=30, same agent analysis.v5 + Opus judge) measured a 0.000 hallucination rate, comfortably under the < 0.05 target; a full n=100 re-run to refresh this snapshot's headline number is pending.
